human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Create a deterministic Run Report serializer from stored projection/signals plus evidence references. Produce machine JSON and human Markdown sections: Outcome, Why stopped, Timeline summary refs, Governance, Validation, Changes, Runtime, Evidence. Do not use an LLM. Dependency: 8015.persist-projections-signals.
human_pressure.why_now: The single-run report is the first user-facing governance product surface and the foundation for later UI.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: No raw artifact body embedding by default.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Implement source-neutral JSON/Markdown Run Report generation from derived projection and evidence refs.
red_lines: No raw artifact body embedding by default.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8015.persist-projections-signals. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Report is a view over derived/raw evidence.
contracts: Observed facts and optional analysis remain separate.
failure_semantics: Missing projection/report component is shown as unavailable/unknown, not pass.

steps.title: Define report DTO
details: List signals and decision reasons with refs.

steps.title: Build deterministic why-stopped section
details: Use terminal execution-control decision and relevant signals.
If unavailable, state unknown; do not invent explanation.

steps.title: Build detail sections
details: Validation, changes, runtime roles/fallbacks, evidence index.
Timeline is summarized from evidence, not rewritten by AI.

steps.title: Render JSON and Markdown
details: Stable ordering and no generated current timestamp inside content identity.
Artifact links are logical refs, not unsafe file URLs.

acceptance: Report exposes outcome, validation, scope, signals, decisions, runtime facts, evidence refs.
Why-stopped is deterministic and says unknown when evidence is insufficient.
JSON and Markdown are stable for same stored state.

must_check: Every warning/failure explanation has evidence refs.
Report does not recompute runtime policy.
reject_if: LLM is required to render facts.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
